The suffix يَ on مَّعِيَ marks the first-person possessor of مَعَ.
ٱللَّهُ remains the explicit subject of the alternative verb رَحِمَنَا.
The full utterance هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ... مُّبِينٍ is the quoted content of قُلْ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ is the predicate of هُوَ.
The pronoun هِ in بِهِ is governed by بِ as complement of ءَامَنَّا.
تَوَكَّلْنَا is coordinated with ءَامَنَّا.
The pronoun هِ in عَلَيْهِ is governed by عَلَى as complement of تَوَكَّلْنَا.
سَتَعْلَمُونَ governs the indirect question مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ.
فِي ضَلَالٍ is the prepositional predicate of هُوَ.
ضَلَالٍ is governed by فِي in the predicate of هُوَ.
مُّبِينٍ agrees with and modifies ضَلَالٍ.
The full utterance أَرَأَيْتُمْ ... مَّعِينٍ is the quoted content of قُلْ.
أَرَأَيْتُمْ governs the conditional question beginning إِنْ أَصْبَحَ.
مَاؤُكُمْ is the ism of أَصْبَحَ.
The suffix كُمْ on مَاؤُكُمْ is the genitive possessor of مَاء.
غَوْرًا is the predicate of أَصْبَحَ.
مَن is the interrogative subject of يَأْتِيكُم.
The suffix كُم on يَأْتِيكُم is the object reached by يَأْتِي.
مَاءٍ is governed by بِ as the thing brought by يَأْتِي.
مَّعِينٍ agrees with and modifies مَاءٍ.
